thread:
alex: quick sync - on a staging run we saw two nodes accept writes for the same prefix during a rapid rebalance. not customer-facing but breaks assumptions for our reconcile jobs.

alex: logs:
```
2026-04-10T14:03:00Z CLAIM node=node-a prefix=/profiles/ era=301 token=node-a|301
2026-04-10T14:03:00Z CLAIM node=node-b prefix=/profiles/ era=301 token=node-b|301
2026-04-10T14:03:01Z WRITE node=node-a key=usr:7 op=put
2026-04-10T14:03:01Z WRITE node=node-b key=usr:7 op=put
2026-04-10T14:03:02Z RESOLVE winner=node-b loser=node-a evict=issued
```

mina: that's a dual-write. we should never have both nodes accept writes. sounds like Claim() allowed both to become write-capable before eviction.

jordan: we could add a cheap fencing token generated at Claim() and CAS-replicated; writes must present current token or be rejected. avoids central sequencer but prevents dual-writes.

alex: agreed. POC idea: Claim() returns fence_token and commit_seq. runtime caches token locally and write-path checks meta.token == provided_token. if mismatch return 409.

mina: tradeoffs: additional meta check on every write adds 1-2ms. but most prefixes are long-lived so amortized cost is small.

jordan: to reduce overhead, let hot-internal writes skip the round-trip if they have token fresh < 100ms old; otherwise revalidate. also add `write_token_misses` metric.

opsbot: note: created ticket INF-4620 for fencing token POC and metrics.

alex: tests: unit for token mismatch -> 409, integration simulating concurrent claim+write ensuring only one succeed, chaos test with partition.

mina: action: mina -> open POC PR with token check + metrics by 4/12. jordan -> bench latency on hot write path after POC by 4/13. alex -> add SDK mapping for `PrefixDemoted`/`TokenMismatch` errors (help callers recover).

alex: also include a `handoff_trace_id` in meta for postmortems. keep off by default.

jordan: if POC looks good, medium-term plan is two-phase handoff where outgoing sets DEMOTED (reads OK, writes 409) and incoming waits for fence_token confirmation before enabling writes.

alex: sounds good. will follow-up in PR.
